scenarios.name: enter-from-admin-menu
scenarios.why: option 6 of COADM01C (XCTL, context 0): CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is COADM01C and not re-entered, so 0000-MAIN INITIALIZEs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA; WHEN CDEMO-PGM-ENTER AND TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED sends the empty screen ('Enter transaction type to be maintained', the type field unprotected) and returns re-entered

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the same fresh start as from the menu

scenarios.name: enter-from-list-pf2
scenarios.why: COTRTLIC's PF2 XCTL (the EIB keeps PF2): from COTRTLIC and not re-entered -> INITIALIZE; 0001-CHECK-PFKEYS finds PF2 invalid and sets 'Invalid key pressed', but the fresh-start WHEN INITIALIZEs WS-MISC-STORAGE, so the empty screen goes out without it

scenarios.name: search-found
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER: 1150-STORE-MAP-IN-NEW keeps '01', 1210-EDIT-TRANTYPE (1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD) accepts it; 2000-DECIDE-ACTION (TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED) runs 9000-READ-TRANTYPE: the SELECT finds PURCHASE -> TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS, the description unprotected, F4 / F12 shown

scenarios.name: search-one-digit
scenarios.why: '1' then a blank passes TEST-NUMVAL; 1210-EDIT-TRANTYPE re-edits NUMVAL into '01', which the SELECT finds

scenarios.name: search-not-found
scenarios.why: the SELECT returns +100: 9100-GET-TRANSACTION-TYPE sets 'No record found for this key in database' -> TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND ('Press F05 to add. F12 to cancel', the key red, F5 / F12 shown)

scenarios.name: search-blank
scenarios.why: 1150 stores LOW-VALUES for a blank key; 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD: 'Tran Type code must be supplied.'; 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS marks the field '*' in red

scenarios.name: search-not-numeric
scenarios.why: TEST-NUMVAL fails: 'Tran Type code must be numeric.'; 1200 sets TTUP-INVALID-SEARCH-KEYS then TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, the key red

scenarios.name: search-zero
scenarios.why: NUMVAL is 0: 'Tran Type code must not be zero.'

scenarios.name: pf4-before-search-invalid-key
scenarios.why: PF4 is valid only with details shown or a delete pending: 0001-CHECK-PFKEYS sets 'Invalid key pressed' and WHEN WS-INVALID-KEY-PRESSED resends the search screen

scenarios.name: not-found-enter-same-key
scenarios.why: 'X' and the same key: 1150 keeps the stored key, 1200 resets TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and skips the edits; the SELECT runs again and finds nothing: the not-found screen again

scenarios.name: not-found-other-key
scenarios.why: 'X' and a different key: 1150 stores it, so 1200 finds the key equal to the stored one, resets TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and skips the key edits (1210); the SELECT finds PAYMENT -> 'S'

scenarios.name: pf5-on-not-found-starts-add
scenarios.why: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND: TTUP-CREATE-NEW-RECORD, 'Enter new transaction type details.', the description unprotected

scenarios.name: add-enter-details
scenarios.why: 'R': 1200 skips the key edit (TTUP-CREATE-NEW-RECORD); 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW sees a change, 1230-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD accepts the description -> TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED: 'Changes validated.Press F5 to save', all protected

scenarios.name: add-description-blank
scenarios.why: 'R' with the description left blank: 'Transaction Desc must be supplied.', TTUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK, '*' in red

scenarios.name: pf5-inserts-new-type
scenarios.why: 'N', no old record: 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING's UPDATE finds no row (+100), so 9700-INSERT-RECORD INSERTs type 20 and SYNCPOINTs -> TTUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE, 'Changes committed to database'. The VARCHAR length is FUNCTION LENGTH of the 50-byte field: the row keeps the blanks after GIFT CARD

scenarios.name: pf12-cancels-add
scenarios.why: 'N' and PF12: 2000-DECIDE-ACTION (the filter flag is not valid) -> 'Update was cancelled', TTUP-CHANGES-BACKED-OUT; with no old record the search prompt and the key field come back

scenarios.name: edit-description
scenarios.why: 'S', a new description: 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW finds a change, 1230 accepts it -> TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, the confirmation prompt, F5 / F12 shown

scenarios.name: edit-no-change-case-only
scenarios.why: the description compares upper-cased and trimmed: 'No change detected with respect to values fetched.', the stored details shown again

scenarios.name: edit-description-blank
scenarios.why: the description cleared: 'Transaction Desc must be supplied.', TTUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK ('Update transaction type details shown.'), '*' in red

scenarios.name: edit-description-not-alphanumeric
scenarios.why: 1230-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD: a '-' is neither a letter, a digit nor a blank -> 'Transaction Desc can have numbers or alphabets only.', red

scenarios.name: pf5-saves-update
scenarios.why: 'N' and PF5: 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING UPDATEs type 01 (SQLCODE 0, SYNCPOINT) -> 'Changes committed to database'; the 50-byte description is written with its trailing blanks

scenarios.name: pf12-cancels-update
scenarios.why: 'N' and PF12: 'Update was cancelled', TTUP-CHANGES-BACKED-OUT, the stored description shown again ('Update transaction type details shown.'); no SQL

scenarios.name: pf12-on-details-starts-over
scenarios.why: PF12 with 'S': the first EVALUATE simulates a fresh entry (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED) -> the empty search screen

scenarios.name: invalid-key-on-details
scenarios.why: PF7 is not handled: 'Invalid key pressed', the details screen again

scenarios.name: pf4-asks-delete-confirmation
scenarios.why: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK04 AND TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS: TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE, 'Delete this record ? Press F4 to confirm', all protected, ENTER's label dark

scenarios.name: pf4-confirms-delete
scenarios.why: '9' and PF4: 9800-DELETE-PROCESSING DELETEs type 08 (no category rows) and SYNCPOINTs -> TTUP-DELETE-DONE, 'Delete successful.'

scenarios.name: pf4-delete-refused-child-rows
scenarios.why: type 01 has rows in TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY (ON DELETE RESTRICT): the DELETE returns -532; 9800 builds 'Please delete associated child records first:SQLCODE : -532:' with SQLERRM OF SQLCA (twice, cut at 75) and leaves TTUP-START-DELETE ('8'), shown with the search prompt; nothing deleted

scenarios.name: pf4-delete-row-gone
scenarios.why: the type confirmed for deletion is no longer in the table: the DELETE returns +100 -> WHEN OTHER: 'Delete failed with message:SQLCODE :  100:' with SQLERRM, TTUP-DELETE-FAILED ('Changes unsuccessful', the key red)

scenarios.name: pf12-cancels-delete
scenarios.why: '9' and PF12: 2000-DECIDE-ACTION -> 'Delete was cancelled', back to the empty search screen; nothing deleted

scenarios.name: enter-while-confirming-delete
scenarios.why: ENTER is not valid while a delete awaits confirmation: 'Invalid key pressed', the confirmation screen again

scenarios.name: enter-after-update-starts-over
scenarios.why: 'C' (TTUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE): the first EVALUATE simulates a fresh entry -> the empty search screen

scenarios.name: enter-after-delete-starts-over
scenarios.why: '7' (TTUP-DELETE-DONE): the same fresh start

scenarios.name: pf3-back-to-admin
scenarios.why: PF3: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID / -PROGRAM are blank (cleared on entry), so CA00 / COADM01C; SYNCPOINT and XCTL with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (FROM CTTU / COTRTUPC, admin user, context 0)

notes: CardDemo's Db2 transaction-type maintenance screen (transaction CTTU, program COTRTUPC, admin menu option 6 or PF2 on COTRTLIC): a type code is validated and looked up in CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE; a found type's description can be changed (ENTER validates, PF5 saves, PF12 cancels) or the type deleted (PF4, PF4 again to confirm); a type not found can be added (PF5, the description, ENTER, PF5: the UPDATE finds no row and the program INSERTs). The state between screens is TTUP-CHANGE-ACTION and the old / new details in the program's own COMMAREA area after CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; on entry the program INITIALIZEs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, so every later screen carries an empty CardDemo area with context 1 -- the scenarios give that state. Both sides run their SQL on one real Db2 (tests/tools/equivalence_db2.py): TRANSACTION_TYPE and TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY (whose ON DELETE RESTRICT foreign key makes deleting type 01 return -532) are created from the corpus DDL, seeded before each scenario and both compared after it. The seed is the corpus's DB2LTTYP.ctl and DB2LTCAT.ctl INSERTs unchanged, plus five types (08-12) without category rows in a separate INSERT, written for this case and its sibling carddemo-cotrtlic (08 is the type a delete can remove). Not covered: the -911 / other negative SQLCODE branches and a duplicate key on the INSERT, which real data cannot reach (the INSERT runs only after the UPDATE found no row), and the 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' ABEND-ROUTINE.
